about_the_game:
MASTER A DEADLY ARSENAL


From silent crossbows to heavy-duty rocket launchers, pick the perfect tool for the job. Whether favoring stealth or explosive force, your diverse weaponry ensures you’re always ready for the dangers of Kyrat.

EXPLORE THE HEIGHTS OF KYRAT


Navigate the most vertical and diverse FARCRY open world yet. From lush forests to snow-capped mountain peaks, scout enemy territory from above in the gyrocopter before plummeting through valleys in your wingsuit to get the upper hand.

UNLEASH THE POWER OF THE WILD


Kyrat is home to abundant and dangerous wildlife, from leopards and rhinos to vicious honey badgers. Turn the tide of battle by climbing aboard a six-ton war elephant to smash through enemy outposts and crush Pagan Min's forces with raw, animal power.

DROP-IN OPEN WORLD CO-OP


Don’t face the wilderness alone. Invite a friend to drop in and out of your game at any time to explore the living world of Kyrat together. Coordinate attacks on fortified outposts and hunt legendary beasts in this open world playground.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz Intel® Core™ i5-750 or 3.2 GHz AMD Phenom™ II X4 955
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or AMD Radeon HD5850 (1 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible (5.1 surround sound recommended)
  • Additional Notes: Windows-compatible keyboard, mouse, optional controller (Xbox 360 Controller for Windows recommended)
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Intel® Core™ i5-2400S or 4.0 GHz AMD FX-8350 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 680 or AMD Radeon R9 290X or better (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible (5.1 surround sound recommended)
  • Additional Notes: Supported video cards at the time of release: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or better, GeForce GTX 700 series; AMD Radeon HD5850 or better, Radeon R9 series. Note: Laptop versions of these cards may work but are NOT officially supported.
developers: Ubisoft Montreal, Red Storm, Shanghai, Toronto, Kiev
